model_annotation: The plot illustrates the sharpness composition over training steps. The x-axis represents the training steps on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 37700, with tick labels at regular intervals of approximately 7540. The y-axis represents the sharpness composition on a logarithmic scale. There are three lines in the plot: one blue line with no markers and a solid line style, one orange line with no markers and a solid line style, and one brown line with no markers and a solid line style. The blue line starts approximately at 1 and increases to around 10^0, then remains steady; the orange line starts approximately at 10^-0.25 and increases to around 10^0, then remains steady; the brown line starts approximately at 10^0 and decreases to around -10^0, then remains steady.
